Subject: SIG/CAIQ + VPC peering evidence request (eu-west-1)

Hi Olga,

Thanks for taking this on. We're in the final stages of our procurement security review and have two asks so we can close the packet: 

1) Completed SIG spreadsheet (we attached a baseline) and a short CAIQ snapshot for the services you're providing to Primus Health.
2) Diagram + evidence showing how private peering is configured for eu-west-1 — we need to confirm that customer traffic never traverses public internet paths and that the peering is bounded to a dedicated VPC/VPC-peering or PrivateLink endpoint.

The security team also wants confirmation on the following controls: HSM-backed key management (KMS separation per-tenant or partition), egress IP ranges for compliance firewall rules, and whether any on-prem connectivity will traverse a shared transit VPC.

I've attached Primus_SIG_questions.xlsx and our CAIQ template for your convenience. Ideally we can get the artifacts by EOD Monday (2025-09-15) to stay on our onboarding schedule.

Thanks — feel free to loop in the ops/infra person who can point to runbooks or a diagram.

Best,
Elena
Security Engineering
Primus Health

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear list. We're on it. Quick clarifying items so we prepare exactly what you need: 

- Region confirmation: you listed eu-west-1 on the PO; we will prepare diagrams for eu-west-1 only unless you request multi-region.
- Peering type: do you need a diagram for PrivateLink (service endpoint) OR VPC peering (route table based)? We can provide both but wanted to confirm which you prefer for inclusion in the packet.
- Egress IP ranges: do you need the full set of ephemeral egress ranges used by our autoscaling nodes, or just the IPs for the control-plane/egress NAT that Primus will whitelist?

Plan: Grace (cc'd) will assemble control mappings (SIG -> internal control ID) and I will collate the CAIQ snapshot. Marcus will capture the keystore/KMS partitioning details. We should be able to produce an evidence bundle with redacted topology and a control mapping by EOD Monday, 2025-09-15. If you need it sooner we can accelerate.

--
Olga Petrov

From: marcus.lin@redwood.com

Date: 2025-09-13T08:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG/CAIQ + VPC peering evidence request (eu-west-1)

Adding technical detail from infra/ops side: 

- KMS/HSM: We use a tenant-aware KMS model where customer keys can be stored in isolated key rings per-account. For high-compliance customers we offer HSM-backed key stores via our KMS provider; we can provide the KMS key resource IDs and a control narrative on separation.
- Peering topology: For eu-west-1 we typically offer two options: (A) Dedicated VPC peering between Redwood's tenant VPC and customer VPC (route tables + security group lockdown), or (B) PrivateLink with an interface endpoint in the customer's VPC that terminates into our private NLBs. We will mark which approach Primus has chosen on the PO and include that diagram.
- Egress: We can provide a stable NAT egress pool (list of 5 IPs) that is used for customer-controlled outbound traffic; we will include those IPs in the evidence pack.
- Runbooks & audits: We'll include the runbook that shows step-by-step peering teardown and rebuild (RBAC controls + approval workflow).

I've attached a CSV extract of the keystore map and a short control narrative snippet (kv-keystore-map.csv). If you can confirm you want the full SOC 2 artifact (SOC 2 Type II bridge letter vs full report) we'll route the request to legal and security to confirm sharing terms.

- Marcus
Principal Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: kv-keystore-map.csv

Thanks Marcus/Olga — that addresses most of our questions. A couple of follow-ups: 

- Primus will accept either PrivateLink or dedicated VPC peering; please include whichever is the active configuration for our account (we believe PrivateLink was chosen but please confirm).
- Please include the 5 NAT egress IPs (we will add them to our firewall allowlist).
- For SOC 2: we require either the SOC 2 Type II report redacted to remove unrelated customers OR a SOC 2 bridge letter plus the control matrix. If it helps, we can accept a SOC 2 bridge + control matrix now and receive the full redacted Type II within 30 days.

Also: can you push a signed diagram or a short PDF that we can upload to our vendor platform? I'll send a DocuSign request for a confirmation letter that the peering is in place and that traffic does not traverse the public internet.

DocuSign link (Primus request): https://na1.docusign.net/Signing/?t=FAKE-DOCUSIGN-12345

Best,
Elena
